jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - AV Engineering
jobs.work_authorization_display: Open / Not specified; No work authorization requirement stated

classification_paths.evidence_quote: Senior Technical Program Manager - AV Engineering
classification_paths.industry_evidence_quote: Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience

jobs.summary: This role leads AV Engineering programmes from vehicle-platform bring-up to on-vehicle delivery, coordinating across software, hardware, and robotics teams. The candidate must possess five years of experience leading complex multi-team programmes and demonstrate strong technical understanding of autonomy systems and vehicle platforms.
jobs.description_excerpt: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.work_authorization_display: Open / Not specified; Sponsorship available; no explicit authorization requirement

classification_paths.industry_evidence_quote: Join the product team at an early-stage AI company building tools for data engineering teams.

jobs.summary: This role requires at least three years of product management experience, including work at an early-stage startup and experience bringing technical products from concept to launch. The candidate must have experience building or managing products for data engineers with strong knowledge of the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, data warehousing, or orchestration. The position also requires experience launching native generative AI products and familiarity with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI evaluation.
jobs.description_excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE Join the product team at an early-stage AI company building tools for data engineering teams. You will shape and launch capabilities for an AI-powered data platform, working closely with customers, engineering, design, sales, support, and marketing. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build product strategy and roadmap by engaging with users and identifying high-impact data engineering use cases.
